title: Tools
description: Explore a variety of practical tools we offer, including subtitle processing, text translation, and file renaming, to help you complete tasks efficiently.

sub_desc.subtitle_tools: AI translation, format conversion, and other subtitle processing features.
sub_desc.text_tools: Side-by-side translation and review for long TXT / Markdown texts.

field_desc.subtitle_translator: Translate subtitle files with AI models
field_desc.subtitle_formatter: Convert between SRT, VTT, ASS, SSA, SBV and LRC
field_desc.subtitle_language_extractor: Extract a specific language from bilingual subtitles
field_desc.local_subtitle_transcriber: Batch transcribe audio or video into SRT / LRC subtitles with an on-device model
field_desc.name_translator: Tick files and folders (including nested items), translate their names with AI, review and edit, then rename in one go with undo
field_desc.text_translator: Import TXT or Markdown or paste text, compare source and translation segment by segment, try a sample, pause and resume, then review and export
field_desc.media_converter: Compress videos, convert audio and video formats or extract audio, all on this computer with nothing uploaded
field_desc.subtitle_studio: Transcribe, translate and batch export bilingual subtitles

chips.studio_formats: SRT · VTT · ASS · SSA · SBV · LRC

catalog.intro: Good tools. More freedom to create.
catalog.knowledge_description: Keep context, terminology and translation requirements together in a reusable library.
catalog.classic_description: Established standalone tools for everyday subtitle tasks.
catalog.media_description: Tools for audio and video files that run entirely on this computer.
catalog.experimental_description: This tool is in beta, with features and usability still being refined. It is not yet recommended for production work. Prefer the tools above.
